diagnosis: Essential Systemic Hypertension with Mild Palpitations
symptoms: Occasional exertional breathlessness, headache in the mornings

medicines.name: Telmisartan 40mg
medicines.instructions: Take at fixed hour. Monitor BP weekly.

advice: Low sodium diet (<3g salt/day), 30 minutes brisk walking daily. Avoid strenuous weightlifting.

medicines.name: Metformin 500mg SR
medicines.instructions: Take with meals to minimize GI distress.

advice: Strict glycemic control, avoid refined carbohydrates and sweets. Retest fasting blood glucose in 4 weeks.

symptoms: Dry cough, wheezing on exertion, sneezing

medicines.name: Budesonide Inhaler 200mcg
medicines.instructions: Rinse mouth thoroughly with water after inhalation.

advice: Steam inhalation twice daily. Avoid cold beverages and air pollutants.
